verification_notes.note: Clarified that the EBIT margin adjustment (to 15.2%) excludes tariff costs and FX headwinds impacting the reported margin, preserving factual accuracy while enhancing precision.

Split into two distinct units (SureSight Mobile launch and Recircle Program blade-collection extension) to comply with the Distinct-Event Rule, as these are separate strategic initiatives that could reasonably be included or omitted independently in a concise summary.

redundancy_check.note: All final units were cross-checked for duplicate evaluation targets. No pairs substantially evaluate the same content. Each unit covers a mutually non-overlapping material fact, event, or evaluation target.

key_information_units.information: Q1 2025/26 revenue increased organically by 8.6% to DKK 1,558m (reported growth of 3.2%), driven by Endoscopy Solutions growth and regional performance in North America (9.8%) and Europe (9.7%).
key_information_units.source_evidence: Revenue increased organically by 8.6% (19.5%) to DKK 1,558m (DKK 1,510m), with reported growth of 3.2% (20.4%). Revenue growth was driven by solid organic growth in North America and Europe, respectively posting 9.8% (19.2%) and 9.7% (17.1%). Endoscopy Solutions grew organically by 14.4%.

key_information_units.information: EBIT before special items was DKK 164m with a margin of 10.5%; adjusted for tariff costs and FX headwinds, the underlying EBIT margin was 15.2%, reflecting operational leverage despite external pressures.
key_information_units.source_evidence: EBIT before special items (b.s.i.) was DKK 164m (DKK 243m), with an EBIT margin b.s.i. of 10.5% (16.1%), negatively impacted by tariff costs and FX headwind. Adjusting for tariff costs and FX, Ambu generated an EBIT margin of 15.2%.

key_information_units.information: Endoscopy Solutions grew organically by 14.4%, primarily driven by Urology, ENT & GI (21.0% growth from aScope 4 portfolio) and Respiratory (8.3% growth from bronchoscopy solutions and the SureSight video laryngoscope launch).
key_information_units.source_evidence: Endoscopy Solutions grew by 14.4% organically... The Urology, ENT, & GI business group posted 21.0% organic growth, mainly driven by the aScope 4 portfolio... The Respiratory business group posted 8.3% organic growth, driven by... the launch of the SureSight video laryngoscope solution.

key_information_units.information: Anesthesia & Patient Monitoring reported flat organic growth of -0.1%, impacted by extraordinarily high comparable revenue from Q1 2024/25.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Anesthesia & Patient Monitoring posted flat organic growth of -0.1% (17.8%), reflecting an extraordinarily high revenue achieved in the same quarter last year.

key_information_units.information: Geographic revenue growth varied significantly: North America +9.8%, Europe +9.7%, and Rest of World -1.6% due to order fluctuations and high prior-year comparables.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Revenue growth was driven by solid organic growth in North America and Europe, respectively posting 9.8% (19.2%) and 9.7% (17.1%). Rest of World declined by -1.6% (28.0%), due to order fluctuations and high comparable revenue from last year.

key_information_units.information: Free cash flow before acquisitions was DKK 13m (down from DKK 69m), primarily due to increased net working capital, FX headwinds, and tariff costs.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Free cash flow (FCF) before acquisitions totaled DKK 13m (DKK 69m). This was mainly negatively impacted by a change in net working capital... FCF was also impacted by both FX headwind and tariff costs.

key_information_units.information: DKK 90m dividend was paid per share (DKK 0.41) and DKK 38m was used to acquire treasury shares as part of the Q1 share buyback program.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Ambu paid out DKK 90m in dividend in Q1, corresponding to DKK 0.41 per share. In addition, DKK 38m was used to acquire treasury shares in Q1 as part of Ambu’s share buyback program.

key_information_units.information: The portable SureSight Mobile video laryngoscope was launched, expanding Ambu’s video laryngoscope portfolio for pre-hospital and hospital intubation settings.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Introduction of Ambu’s portable video laryngoscope solution, SureSight Mobile, expanding Ambu’s video laryngoscope portfolio and Respiratory offering. The solution enables clinicians to perform emergent intubations swiftly in demanding environments.

key_information_units.information: The Ambu Recircle Program was extended to include collection and recycling of blades from the SureSight video laryngoscopy solution, planned for 2026.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Extension of the Ambu Recircle Program to include the collection and recycling of blades from Ambu’s video laryngoscopy solution, Ambu SureSight Connect, in 2026.

key_information_units.information: Full-year 2025/26 financial guidance was maintained: organic revenue growth of 10-13% and EBIT margin before special items of 12-14% (14-16% excluding tariff impacts).
key_information_units.source_evidence: The 2025/26 financial guidance is maintained... Organic revenue growth: 10-13%... EBIT margin b.s.i.: 12-14%... 14-16% excluding assumed impacts of ~2%-pts given the current schedule of expected tariffs.

key_information_units.information: Sustainability milestones included operationalization of the Ambu Recircle Program across four markets and production of the first batch of recycled material from endoscopes.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Ambu continues to advance its recycling program, which now operates in four markets... A key Q1 milestone was the production of the first batch of recycled material derived from collected endoscopes.
